queries: WITH sex_counts AS (SELECT CASE WHEN p.SEX IS NULL THEN 'missing' WHEN TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN 'blank' ELSE 'recorded' END AS sex_status, CASE WHEN p.SEX IS NULL OR TRIM(p.SEX) = '' THEN NULL ELSE p.SEX END AS sex, COUNT(DISTINCT e.ID) AS examined_count FROM Examination AS e LEFT JOIN Patient AS p ON p.ID = e.ID GROUP BY 1, 2), stats AS (SELECT SUM(examined_count) AS total_examined, AVG(examined_count * 1.0) AS average_per_sex FROM sex_counts), per_sex AS (SELECT c.sex_status, c.sex, c.examined_count, c.examined_count * 1.0 / NULLIF(s.total_examined, 0) AS share_of_total, s.average_per_sex FROM sex_counts AS c CROSS JOIN stats AS s) SELECT 'sex' AS row_type, sex_status, sex, examined_count, share_of_total, NULL AS average_excess_count FROM per_sex UNION ALL SELECT 'above_average', NULL, NULL, COALESCE(SUM(examined_count), 0), AVG(share_of_total), AVG(examined_count - average_per_sex) FROM per_sex WHERE examined_count > average_per_sex;

WITH sex_counts AS (SELECT p.SEX AS sex, COUNT(DISTINCT p.ID) AS examined_patients FROM Patient AS p JOIN Examination AS e ON e.ID = p.ID GROUP BY p.SEX), totals AS (SELECT SUM(examined_patients) AS overall_total, AVG(1.0 * examined_patients) AS per_sex_average FROM sex_counts) SELECT 'sex' AS row_type, s.sex, s.examined_patients, 1.0 * s.examined_patients / NULLIF(t.overall_total, 0) AS share_of_overall, NULL AS combined_total, NULL AS average_share, NULL AS average_above_per_sex_average FROM sex_counts AS s CROSS JOIN totals AS t UNION ALL SELECT 'above_average_summary', NULL, NULL, NULL, COALESCE(SUM(s.examined_patients), 0), AVG(1.0 * s.examined_patients / NULLIF(t.overall_total, 0)), AVG(s.examined_patients - t.per_sex_average) FROM sex_counts AS s CROSS JOIN totals AS t WHERE s.examined_patients > t.per_sex_average
